spell.description: Exact spell name. A charged variant is a separate name, e.g. 'Comet - Charged'; the result lists every form.

catalyst.description: The staff or seal, by exact catalogue name, from weapon-lookup's `resolved`.

catalyst_class.description: weapon-lookup's `weapon_class` for the catalyst. Optional, but pass it: with it, casting from something that is not a catalyst is refused before the node runs.

max_upgrade.description: The catalyst's cap, from weapon-lookup. Staves vary: some reach +25 without taking any affinity.

starting_class.description: The class the character started as. Not cosmetic: planner.py uses a class's stats as a floor, so a build with 9 intelligence computed as a Wretch is computed at 10. Pass the real class — the default is Wretch and it lifts every stat below ten.

spell_type.description: The kind of spell, when you know it. Paired with catalyst_class it refuses an impossible cast before the node runs.
